claim.statement: A current Harness Run can force DeepSeek Provider traffic through the Workstation native-a loopback CONNECT transport, execute one real observation-only Runtime workspace Tool through loopback MCP, consume the Tool observation, and complete on the next Provider turn without changing Runtime ExecutionProfile or adding automatic Provider failover.

finalConclusion.summary: The symbol HarnessRuntimeClient is defined in src/ordivon_harness/runtime_port.py at line 10.

composition.providerPath: Harness DeepSeek adapter -> HTTPS_PROXY 127.0.0.1:19081 -> Workstation native-a sidecar -> external DeepSeek
composition.toolPath: Harness SQLiteRuntimeBridge -> application-supplied Host McpRuntimeClient -> http://127.0.0.1:8897/mcp -> Runtime workspace.exec
composition.note: Host McpRuntimeClient was used only as the application-supplied live RuntimeClient implementation; Harness source gained no Host dependency.

knownLimits: Surfshark was not physically disabled. Provider-path separation is established by the digest-bound native-a environment and the previously verified loopback CONNECT transport semantics, not by a destructive VPN shutdown.
This acceptance proves functional inference-plus-Tool continuity through DeepSeek native-a; it does not provide an OpenAI secondary path or generic global Internet reachability.

OpenAI direct native egress remained unavailable in point-in-time observations, and separate Cloudflare Worker and AI Gateway probes reached OpenAI but were rejected with unsupported_country_region_territory.
Network reachability remains point-in-time physical truth. The network profile digest binds transport semantics, not perpetual destination reachability.
The Runtime Tool was observation-only search_workspace. Effectful Tool continuity remains governed by the existing Runtime effect/recovery contracts and was not re-proven here.
A broader independent external egress/VPS would add failure-domain diversity but is not required for this demonstrated Ordivon functional continuity path.
